comments.author: @rasel...t.g.c
comments.text:
As a Bangladeshi, I appreciate people’s interest in showing the realities of my country. Bangladesh certainly has serious problems—pollution, overcrowding, poverty, traffic and unsafe working conditions are real issues.

However, this video presents a very one-sided picture of Bangladesh. Most of the narrative is focused on Dhaka and on the most negative aspects of life. Bangladesh is much more than Dhaka. There are rural communities, forests, rivers, wetlands, beaches, historical places, diverse cultures and millions of ordinary people living very different lives across the country.

I was also concerned to see footage that appears to be from outside Bangladesh being presented in a video about Bangladesh. If footage is used from another country, it should be clearly identified.

Documentaries should show problems, but they should also provide context and represent the country fairly. A country should not be judged by its worst streets, poorest neighbourhoods or most polluted places alone.

I hope future videos about Bangladesh will explore the country beyond Dhaka and show both its challenges and its diversity.
